name: nrk
description: NRK (Norwegian Broadcasting) news, sport, culture, TV and radio: the CLI reads news collections and articles, tag, author and review listings, TV/radio broadcast schedules, playback metadata and manifests, radio/podcast catalogs and NRK TV page plugs.

commands.name: get-content
commands.summary: Get an nrk.no content item (article teaser, news collection or stream such as 'Krigen i Ukraina' or the sports news stream) by its 1.<id>, including its latest related items

params.name: id
params.description: NRK content id in the form 1.<number>, taken from legacy article/collection URLs (…-1.11480927)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: How many related items (relations) to include (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.source: E7 E8 E9 E10 E11 E23 E24 E36 E37 E38 E43 E44 GET https://www.nrk.no/serum/api/content/json/1.14612682

commands.name: list-topic-articles
commands.summary: List articles on an nrk.no topic/tag page (e.g. /atomkraft/, /sverige/) by topic id, newest first, with cursor paging

params.name: cursor
params.description: Paging cursor from the previous page. It is base64 JSON {timestamp, contentId} of the last item seen.

commands.name: list-author-articles
commands.summary: List articles written by an NRK journalist (author profile /forfatter/<slug>-<id>) by author id, with cursor paging

params.name: authorId
params.description: Numeric author id (the trailing number in /forfatter/<slug>-<id>)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Paging cursor from the previous page (base64 JSON {timestamp, contentId} of the last item)

commands.name: list-reviews
commands.summary: List NRK reviews (anmeldelser) of a given category, e.g. books, with score and cursor paging

params.name: reviewType
params.description: Review category key. 'literature' is books (Bøker). Other categories presumably use similar English keys.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Paging cursor from the previous page (base64 JSON {timestamp, contentId} of the last item)

commands.name: list-related-articles
commands.summary: List articles topically related to a given (newer-format /artikkel/<slug>-<id>) article id

params.name: articleId
params.description: Numeric article id (the trailing number in /artikkel/<slug>-<id>)

commands.name: get-epg
commands.summary: Get the broadcast schedule (EPG) for one or more NRK TV/radio channels on a given date

commands.name: get-playback-metadata
commands.summary: Get playback metadata (title, duration, availability, geoblocking, manifest link) for a video clip, TV/radio program, podcast episode or live channel

params.name: id
params.description: Media id. Clips use a UUID, programs ids like MNAN12004326, podcast episodes l_<uuid>, channels ids like nrktv8.

commands.source: E5 E18 E19 E20 E21 E22 E27 E28 E31 E32 E41 E42 E46 E47 E53 GET https://psapi.nrk.no/playback/metadata/clip/{id}

commands.name: get-playback-manifest
commands.summary: Get the playback manifest (stream URLs such as HLS, plus subtitles) for a playable clip, program, podcast episode or channel

commands.name: get-radio-catalog
commands.summary: Get an NRK radio series or podcast catalog entry, including its seasons (months) and links

params.name: slug
params.description: Series/podcast slug, e.g. dagsnytt-atten, politisk-kvarter, kjapt_oppdatert, bakrommet

commands.source: E14 E15 E16 E17 E39 E40 E45 GET https://psapi.nrk.no/radio/catalog/series/politisk-kvarter

commands.name: get-podcast-episode
commands.summary: Get details of a single NRK podcast episode (title, date, duration, contributors, playback link)

commands.name: get-latest-episode
commands.summary: Get the latest (or next upcoming) episode of an NRK TV series, e.g. dagsrevyen or nyheter

params.name: seriesId
params.description: TV series slug, e.g. dagsrevyen, nyheter, rykter

commands.name: get-tv-page
commands.summary: Get an NRK TV page (e.g. the front page) with its sections and plug references

commands.name: get-tv-plug
commands.summary: Resolve an NRK TV plug reference (from get-tv-page plugRefs) to its series/program title, description, images and ids

commands.name: list-clip-collections
commands.summary: List the related video collections shown alongside an nrk.no video clip

notes: Keyword search is not available: /sok is disallowed and no search request was captured.
The legacy article/collection ids look like '1.18057825'. Pass them as-is to get-content. The 'relations' array lists child item ids, which you can also fetch with get-content.

Paging on plugs.json (topic, author and reviews) uses an opaque cursor: base64 JSON {timestamp, contentId} of the last item on the previous page. Pass it back via --cursor. The cursor field name in the response was not recorded.
Topic ids, author ids and review category keys are not exposed as listings. Take them from page URLs (/forfatter/<slug>-<id>) or from earlier results.
Many video clips and TV programs are geoblocked outside Norway (nonPlayable.messageType 'ProgramIsGeoblocked'). Radio and podcast content is usually playable everywhere.
The video person/collection load-more (video/api/v1/loadmore) and regional load-more (serum/api/render/<id> with offset params) are not exposed because their parameters were not fully recorded.
get-epg dates are YYYY-MM-DD in Norwegian local time. Today and tomorrow were confirmed to work.
